wins: Mapped public-facing services with targeted nmap scans to enumerate open web ports and identified server headers indicating Apache 2.4 (ep001_step04).
Captured valid SSH credentials via default credential spraying against detected banner, confirming remote access vector (ep001_step09).
fails: Failed to advance past privilege escalation due to missing local exploit for patched kernel version, leaving the mission incomplete.
Persistence stage stalled after service restart cleared scheduled tasks, indicating insufficient persistence planning.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and initial access succeeded, but exploitation and persistence stages remain unfulfilled; focus on tailored privilege escalation and persistence techniques next.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalled when no exploit matched patched kernel/build, blocking lateral movement.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 is open and web server banner observed
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted directory bruteforce with dirsearch and follow-up nikto scan

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service detected with default banner and no MFA
skill_cards.then_action: Execute hydra credential spray using known default passwords

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying web enumeration paths during reconnaissance.
